Leaflet 1.9.4 is vendored here to keep S3 within its owned files (the shared package manifest belongs to the platform). Source: https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet-src.esm.js and the matching distribution CSS/images. Copyright and BSD-2-Clause licence are in LICENSE. Only upstream ESLint directive comments and the unavailable source-map reference were removed; runtime code is unchanged. leaflet.d.ts describes the small subset used by this feature. Maps use OpenStreetMap raster tiles with visible attribution.
